rule: Both screened class F1 >= current categorical F1 and foreground mean strictly greater; among eligible candidates choose greatest foreground mean, then fewer background FP.
target: Reach or exceed both archived dual-head class F1, not just the foreground mean.
scope: Development selection on the known fixed nine-aircraft set, not independent generalization evidence
historical_dual_head_artifacts: Deleted at user request; benchmark numbers retained in the change record.
historical_candidates: Removed by explicit user request; selected training records retained in training_record/.
